title: xDrip+ update mechanism does not work
symptom: User on nightly 2019-12-31 with alpha channel and auto update check enabled reports not receiving any update notifications and manual 'Check for updated version' only shows 'Checking for update...' for 3 seconds then disappears with no effect.
fix: Ensure the nightly channel is selected, as suggested by a maintainer. The user later confirmed that update works.
evidence_quote: Make sure you have the nightly channel selected
